title: Precise Departure Times
description: A dispatcher who reschedules a shipment three times in a row expects the board to always reflect the LATEST times they set — never a stale window from an earlier drag-and-drop.
successCondition: PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId three times in a row for the same shipment, each time with a distinctly different scheduledStart/scheduledEnd pair. After each call, query the assignments table via `npm run db:psql` and confirm scheduled_start/scheduled_end match exactly that call's submitted values — including after the FIRST and SECOND calls, not just checking the final state, since a bug that only takes effect on odd-numbered updates would slip past a final-state-only check.
hints: Query the DB after each of the three PUT calls, not just once at the end — this challenge is specifically about verifying every intermediate state, not just the destination.
Compare timestamps in UTC (at time zone 'UTC' in your SELECT) to avoid a false mismatch from your psql session's local timezone display.
